description: This file defines the class 'WeightPackageSessionLine', which models a shipment weight package line with various properties such as weight, dimensions, shipment box type, and sequence ID. It includes constructors, getters, setters, and a method to apply the line to a shipment package within a given dispatching context.

classes.name: WeightPackageSessionLine
classes.description: Represents a shipment weight package line with properties for weight, dimensions, shipment box type, and sequence ID. Provides methods to access and modify these properties and to apply the line to a shipment package.

methods.name: WeightPackageSessionLine
methods.description: Constructor initializing all properties of the weight package session line.

methods.name: getShipmentBoxTypeId
methods.description: Returns the shipment box type ID.

methods.name: setShipmentBoxTypeId
methods.description: Sets the shipment box type ID.

methods.name: getWeightPackageSeqId
methods.description: Returns the sequence ID of the weight package.

methods.name: setWeightPackageSeqId
methods.description: Sets the sequence ID of the weight package.

methods.name: getShipmentItemSeqId
methods.description: Returns the shipment item sequence ID.

methods.name: setShipmentItemSeqId
methods.description: Sets the shipment item sequence ID.

methods.name: applyLineToPackage
methods.description: Associates the current line with a shipment package by invoking external service 'addShipmentContentToPackage' and handling errors.
